ideas.pitch: A Python static analysis and runtime configuration validator designed specifically to catch incorrect configurations, port binding collisions, and connection string errors before applications start.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Find the Bug - Incorrect configuration, port-related problems, and database connection issues.
ideas.title: PyTrace Config Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the exact hands-on debugging challenges of Round 1 with a standalone Python utility makes the tool extremely relatable to judges reviewing server failure logs.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight diagnostic utility for Java backend applications that ingests messy stack traces, missing authentication error codes, and API failures, outputting structured root-cause fix plans.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 & 2: API failure, authentication failures, and code bugs in Java server environments.
ideas.title: JavaStack Root Cause Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since teams must work in Java or Python, building an intelligent helper specifically for Java error tracking directly addresses the core skill being tested.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool that parses broken Python server environments, identifies missing database drivers or incorrect port bindings, and automatically generates patch files and test validations.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Debug the Server - investigating malfunctioning applications and attempting to fix underlying problems.
ideas.title: ServerMedic Automated Repair CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It mirrors the exact winning pattern of turning runtime errors into structured repair plans and multi-file fixes, highly appealing for a server debugging competition.

ideas.pitch: A local log aggregation and anomaly detection dashboard built in Python that quickly surfaces silent database timeout exceptions, bad port configurations, and authentication token rejections from raw server logs.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Find the Bug - identifying intentional problems across application server logs and database connections.
ideas.title: LogSleuth Server Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on proven log management systems that win technical hackathons by providing instant visual clarity during server investigations.

ideas.pitch: A testing harness for Python and Java APIs that deliberately breaks endpoints, injects latency, invalidates auth tokens, and then verifies automated recovery sequences.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 & 2: API failure, authentication failures, and server environment troubleshooting.
ideas.title: API Fault Injector & Doctor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a deep mastery of server failure modes by not just fixing bugs, but proactively simulating and diagnosing them during rigorous competition evaluations.
